[{"insert":"Pronated Pull Up + Supinated Pull Up

Same superset as the earlier weeks, but reps drop to 6 so you can add load. The second move is the supinated pull up, palms facing you, which brings your biceps in to squeeze out a few more reps once the pronated pull is fatigued. Match your assistance across both movements and push the supinated set to as many quality reps as possible.
"}]
